items.title: Lizzie Miles Interview, 1951-01-18
items.q: That's where the Frenchman, it was a Frenchman, I think, only, he took them to Paris, he took them to Europe.

ctx.x: Who was there at the Nest? Who was working with you?

Sam Wooding's orchestra was there. And, um, then, uh, let me see, what other people, orchestra was there? Uh, Danny Wilson, that was Edith Wilson's husband, he had a band there. And, oh, there was two, three different bands there, you know, from a minute ago. Because, uh, Sam Wooding's and left them when they opened up the band, that Club Alabama downtown in New York, then they left the Nest to go down to the Club Alabama. That's where the Frenchman, it was a Frenchman, I think, only, he took them to Paris, he…
Did you ever know Albert Wynn? Albert Wynn?
